source: DBS Beerus 01 episode, from 600 s (stream copy, starts on a keyframe)
convention: frame n = first frame of new shot, 0-based decode order

hard_cuts.note: cut from the POV tunnel behind the comet to an outside view where the comet body fills the frame (166-168 almost all white), planets revealed from 169
new shot starts dark (foot on the brake pedal in shadow)
start of a shaky smoke shot (car tail, KAIO plate); camera shakes and Goku revealed inside it, no cut until 1886
start of a long rocking in-car shot (1886-1919), King Kai swings around; framing jumps inside it are not cuts
start of a stepped upward tilt following the sundae glass to Beerus' mouth (2814-2904), treated as one shot

ambiguous.why: CG comet flight 0-165: camera flies through Saturn's ring (80 ring fills the lower half, 81 open space with the comet head at about the same place). Probably a continuous fly-past where the ring leaves frame in one step, but it may be a hidden cut

kitchen shot 727-775: after a hold (753-756) the camera starts a fast lateral track in large 2-4-frame steps (757, 759, 761, 763, 765, 769). Background and staging continue, so judged one shot, but the first step at 757 is big enough to read as a cut

method: Viewed all 37 100-frame filmstrips in order; zoomed frame by frame at 320 px on every doubtful passage (comet/Saturn CG flight 24-93, explosion 102-125, white comet pass 158-181, curtain pan 444-467, kitchen track 753-776, King Kai lean 1656-1679, Goku appearing 1813-1836, smoke/car shake 1846-1891, rocking in-car shot 1890-1921, chef reaction 2519-2542, sundae tilt 2812-2907, boar head shake 3298-3321, finger tap 3529-3552). Checked every hard cut on triplet sheets (n-2..n+1). Candidate outlines used only as hints. No dissolves in this extract.
notable_non_cuts: 0-165 one continuous CG flight behind the comet (camera rolls from vertical to horizontal, passes Saturn, explosion at 104-111 when it hits a planet); 169-347 pan from green planet to yellow planet, then the magenta energy rings grow (same shot); 446-473 throne/curtain slides in front during a pan; 727-775 and 348-381 kitchen tracking shots with characters crossing; 1667-1669 King Kai leans toward the camera; 1826-1833 Goku appears in front of the camera (1826 one-frame flicker, 1827 empty road, then legs), same background; 1856-1885 smoke and camera shake on the car, Goku revealed; 1886-1919 rocking car interior with framing jumps (1889, 1895, 1897, 1905, 1913); 2279-2281 eye blink; 2521-2540 chef jumps up; 2814-2904 stepped tilt following the glass (2818, 2821, 2827, 2830, 2833, 2836, 2842, 2892, 2895 are steps, not cuts); 3302-3315 boar head shake + stepped push-in; 3532-3551 Beerus' finger taps, purple energy ring; 3595-3615 star flash on the planet; the DBS logo overlay appearing in the corner around 1213-1270
annotator: Claude agent, by eye on contact sheets (2026-10-31); independent of any detector
